answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind each identity to cryptographic stake burning via a quadratic burn function where verifying $n$ nodes costs $O(n^2)$. Like a stone jetty buffering against chaotic tides, this economic friction enforces superlinear attacker cost while broadcasting a legitimate coordination signal. Even if an adversary generates identities as effortlessly as writing a sonnet, compounding burn costs render mass Sybil creation economically irrational.
